method_note: Counted the 116 oral technical sessions of the 35th ISTS (Tokushima, 12-18 Jul 2025) in the official Final Program paper list; 496 distinct paper numbers (2025-x-n-m) were counted across them. The technical poster session and the Student Finalist Session (S) were not counted; plenaries, NSAT/special events and the Spacecraft Control System Design Contest excluded. Sessions were mapped by their 19 official technical-session categories, refined per session for categories d (Astrodynamics/GNC), f (Small Satellite), k (Exploration), m and r and for session a-10 (Supersonic). Some session titles were reconstructed from the PDF's broken table layout. Each session = 1 unit split across at most 2 keywords. The next edition (36th, Toyama, July 2027) has not yet taken place. Keywords below 0.02 (air-propulsion, od-nav, osam, rovers, space-robotics; together 0.052 of session-units) were dropped and the remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1. deployable-structures added 2026-10-16: from the same Final Program paper list, session c-1 (Membrane Structures, all 4 papers on membranes) and session c-4 (title reconstructed as 'Analysis and Design'; 4 of 6 papers on deployable booms/origami/thin-film deployment) were moved from structures to deployable-structures: 2/116 raw = 0.0172, x1/0.948 renormalization = 0.018, so structures 0.064 -> 0.046. Not counted because deployable papers are a minority of the session: c-2 (2 of 5: CFRP bistable boom, lattice beams for deployable structures), c-6 (2 of 5: CubeSat dipole antenna deployment mechanism, deployable mesh antenna), c-7 (1 of 4: 16U two-stage deployable solar panel), and f-10 Structure and Thermal Design 2 under smallsat (3 of 5 deployable/membrane-related, left under smallsat because the session title is generic small-satellite structure/thermal design).
